title: 7-OS Component Matrix Variables
description: Configuration variables for the 7-OS Vagrant/cloud compatibility matrix experiment.

OS_FILTER.description: Comma-separated subset of OS targets to execute (alpine,debian,rockylinux,freebsd,omnios,macos,windows, or all).

README_OUT.description: Optional path to the Markdown file updated with the 5-tier, 7-OS Supported Components tables.
